title: Azure Data Architect
description:
Data Platform Architect: £82,000+, Hybrid: Newcastle Upon-Tyne

Are you an experienced Data Platform Architect looking for your next challenge? Join exciting, large-scale projects, helping public sector and regulated clients make the most of modern data and AI technologies.

The Role

  • You will be responsible for:
  • Designing and delivering modern data and AI platforms using Microsoft Azure.
  • Setting technical direction and developing architecture strategies.
  • Bringing Machine Learning, Generative AI and cloud technologies into business solutions.
  • Leading technical teams and managing complex project delivery.
  • Advising senior stakeholders and working closely with clients.
  • Ensuring solutions meet high standards of security, governance and data management.
  • Supporting and mentoring junior engineers and architects.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong Microsoft Azure expertise.
  • Experience with modern data platforms, cloud architecture and AI technologies.
  • Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex projects.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Public sector or regulated industry experience is desirable.

Active SC clearance is essential.


What's on Offer?

  • Salary of £82,000+
  • Competitive benefits package.
  • Interesting and varied client projects.
  • Career progression and development opportunities.
  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
